name: Haste
overview: The topic of haste in Scripture is illustrated through the example of the children of Reuben and Gad in Numbers 32, where they quickly sought to settle in the land east of Jordan due to their great cattle herds. Their request to Moses to receive this land as a possession before crossing the Jordan shows a premature desire to secure comfort and security. Moses challenges their haste by reminding them of the need to support their brethren in battle rather than seeking immediate personal gain, highlighting the importance of patience and faithfulness to God's broader plan.
